cases.title: REQ-19: Declining the first-run prompt keeps the setting false
cases.precondition: First-run telemetry prompt shown.

steps.expected: Setting remains false; telemetry stays off.

cases.title: REQ-19: Payload excludes all sensitive fields
cases.precondition: Telemetry enabled; actions involving VMs/connections executed.

steps.step: Inspect the payload for sensitive data
steps.expected: Payload contains no VM names, file paths, IP addresses, connection URIs/users or hostname.

cases.title: REQ-19: Re-prompt no earlier than 30 days after decline
cases.precondition: First-run prompt declined; controllable elapsed time.

steps.step: Advance to exactly 30 days after the decline (min)
Advance to 31 days after the decline (min+1)

cases.title: REQ-20: Export produces valid JSON schema qemuManager.vmConfig v1 with all fields
cases.precondition: A VM defined in a connection.

steps.expected: JSON with schema qemuManager.vmConfig version 1 containing name, vcpu, ramMb, disks[path,sizeGb,format], network(type,bridge for bridged) and iso.

cases.title: REQ-20: Import a valid config without conflict creates the VM
cases.precondition: Valid v1 config; no VM with that name in the target connection.

steps.expected: VM is created in the target connection.

cases.title: REQ-20: Import a valid config with a name conflict shows the overwrite confirmation
cases.precondition: Valid v1 config; a VM with the same name already exists in the target connection.

steps.expected: Confirmation «VM '{name}' already exists. Overwrite?» is shown with default Cancel.

cases.title: REQ-20: Import an unsupported schema version errors and aborts
cases.precondition: Config with a schema version other than 1.

steps.expected: Error «Unsupported config version: {version}» and import is aborted.

cases.title: REQ-20: Import with invalid or missing fields shows a per-line report and aborts
cases.precondition: Config missing a required field or violating REQ-04 rules.

steps.expected: Report with per-line messages is shown; import is aborted with no partial changes.

cases.title: REQ-20: Cancelling the overwrite confirmation makes no changes
cases.precondition: Overwrite confirmation displayed (default Cancel).

steps.step: Press Cancel on the overwrite confirmation
steps.expected: No changes are made; the existing VM is untouched.

cases.title: REQ-20: Schema version boundary - 1 accepted, 0 and 2 rejected
cases.precondition: Configs with schema versions 1, 0 and 2.

cases.title: REQ-21: Suspend a running VM reaches suspended within 3 s
cases.precondition: VM in running state; runtime supports suspend (VIR_DOMAIN_PMSUSPENDED).

cases.title: REQ-21: Resume a suspended VM reaches running within 3 s
cases.precondition: VM in suspended state.

cases.title: REQ-21: Suspend/Resume are disabled for ineligible states
cases.precondition: VMs in stopped, paused, crashed and running states.

cases.title: REQ-21: libvirt error on suspend/resume leaves the state unchanged and shows the error
cases.precondition: Running/suspended VM; libvirt induced to fail.

steps.step: Invoke Suspend/Resume while libvirt returns an error
steps.expected: State does not change and the error is shown.

cases.comment: F-004 (open, major): REQ-21 has no QMP-only branch, so libvirt-absent behavior is not asserted.

cases.title: REQ-21: 3 s state-change threshold and eligibility matrix
cases.precondition: Running/suspended VMs with controllable transition timing.

steps.step: Check command availability across all states
steps.expected: Suspend enabled only for running; Resume enabled only for suspended.

cases.title: REQ-22: An unexpected VM crash is reflected as the crashed state in the tree
cases.precondition: VM running; its QEMU process is terminated unexpectedly.

steps.expected: VM state in the tree becomes crashed on the next state update.

cases.title: REQ-22: A crashed VM can be recovered via Start
cases.precondition: VM in crashed state.

steps.expected: State becomes running within 5 s per REQ-08.

cases.title: REQ-22: A crash is surfaced even when event subscription is unavailable (polling fallback)
cases.precondition: Event subscription unsupported (REQ-13 fallback active); VM running.

steps.step: Terminate the VM process unexpectedly while polling fallback is active
steps.expected: The crashed state is still reflected in the tree via the next poll.

na_types.reason: Clone defines no numeric/range/limit condition of its own; the name rules it inherits from REQ-04 are boundary-tested under REQ-04.
Delete has no numeric/range/limit condition; only state eligibility and confirmation options apply.
Error handling has no numeric/range/limit condition; the mapping-table content is absent, so message-specific boundaries cannot be derived.
Keybindings have no numeric/range/limit condition; conflict handling is delegated to VS Code.
Crash handling has no numeric/range/limit condition; it describes a discrete state transition, not a range.
